items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: Remember Robert Johnson, the legendary guitar player who went down to the crossroads at midnight and sold his soul to Satan?

ctx.x: Do you have an idea of why black musicians don’t pursue the blues? I mean it’s not like it’s a great way to make a living I suppose, but I think there’s something beyond that.

Yeah, I think there’s some major social issues, that the black musicians want to move beyond that image. I heard a great joke. Remember Robert Johnson, the legendary guitar player who went down to the crossroads at midnight and sold his soul to Satan?
